description: Search CompareFairly's catalog of neutral, sourced comparisons for a given market. Returns matching comparisons (title, slug, url, json_url, popularity). Use this first to find the exact slug, then call get_comparison.

country.description: 2-letter country code (e.g. US, FR, DE, GB). Default: US.

lang.description: 2-letter language code (e.g. en, fr, de, es, it). Default: en.

query.description: Free-text query, e.g. 'best electric car' or 'password manager'.

name: search_comparisons
